integrity: A self-contained exact proof, Python 3 standalone enumeration, independent enumeration comparisons, explicit boundaries and qualified literature comparison are embedded. No external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The signs concern the nondegenerate support of G(n,m). At the critical dense limit only a first-order zero is established; no critical-window asymptotics or priority certification. Covariance is exponentially small for fixed positive edge density because isolation is rare.
title: A universal isolation–motif covariance phase boundary in fixed-edge random graphs
